thread:
maria (Partnerships): FYI — AcmeEdge wants to list their Edge Gateway in the cloud marketplace next quarter. They asked about what we need for security/compliance (SOC reports, pen tests, questionnaire), plus a coordinated joint announcement. Can we sync on required artifacts and timeline?
akash (Eng-Sec): Thanks — rough asks: SOC2 Type II (or attestation), third-party pen test report + remediation summary, network/firmware architecture diagrams, threat model, and list of validated mitigations. Also we need contact for test scoping.
sarah-ops: Timeline constraints: marketplace listing intake deadline is 2026-07-10 for the campaign. We should lock artifacts by 2026-06-20 to allow redaction/review. Can AcmeEdge meet that?
maria (Partnerships): They said dev-integrator will run pen in late May, but we need proof. @dev-integration can you confirm scope and witness needs? Also we'll need a joint comms timeline after approvals.
dev-integration: Confirmed — pen vendor booked for 2026-05-18 to 2026-05-22. Scope includes network services + firmware update flow on the gateway. They asked if Redwood can witness remotely; we can send 2 people. Will upload initial report to presigned S3 once we get it.
kevin-sec: Quick checklist from our side: 1) confirm pen scope doc 2) get vendor attestation + credentials sanitation report 3) provide SOC2 status (Type II preferred) 4) artifact redaction guidance for customer PII 5) coordinate timeline for PR and marketplace listing.
sarah-ops: For uploads: use our secure presign endpoint and mark artifacts with TTL=30d by default. Example command for upload presign: `curl -X POST https://artifact.redwood.ai/presign -d '{"name":"acme-pen-report.pdf","ttl_days":30}'`
marketplace-bot: Checklist link: https://intranet.redwood.ai/marketplace/compliance-checklist — has canonical artifact list (SOC, pen, questionnaire, architecture diagrams, attestation).
akash (Eng-Sec): A few more technical asks: please include firmware SBOM, signed firmware image hashes, and evidence of OTA rollback protections. For the third-party pen, require a high-level finding summary plus controlled reproduction steps for critical issues.
maria (Partnerships): We also need to coordinate the SI integration attestation sheet — fields: integrator name, API scopes used, data flows, least-privilege justification. I'll draft and send to AcmeEdge today.
dev-integration: Noted. On the presign upload, we'll send two artifacts: `acmeedge_pen_report.pdf` and `acmeedge_firmware_sbom.json.gz`. Any redaction rules before upload?
sarah-ops: Redact customer-hosted IPs and any PII. If unsure, mark artifact as "sensitive" and we'll route to sec-team for redaction.
kevin-sec: We also want to schedule a short 30-min review w/ SecOps the week after the vendor delivers initial findings. Proposed: 2026-05-26 10:00-10:30 PT. Who can attend from AcmeEdge?
maria (Partnerships): I'll ask them. Also tagging marketing: after sec signs off, we'll run joint announcement playbook — embargo window is typically 7 days. Need mutual approval on messaging and timing.
akash (Eng-Sec): One more thing: if SOC2 is not final, an interim SOC letter + evidence of controls is acceptable for listing, but we must flag it on the marketplace listing as "In progress — SOC2 Type II".
dev-integration: AcmeEdge confirms SOC report in progress, expected complete 2026-06-15. Pen vendor will provide draft report by 2026-05-28.
sarah-ops: Okay — action items: Maria to collect integrator attestation matrix by EOD; Dev-Integration to upload draft pen report to presign when available; Akash/Kevin to review and provide redaction/tech feedback by 2026-05-30; Ops to prepare presign+TTL and redaction routing.
maria (Partnerships): Sounds good. I'll follow up with a short tracking doc and assign owners. Thanks all :+1:
marketplace-bot: Reminder: attach `marketplace/compliance-templates.zip` to the presign upload for partners to use the redaction templates and attestation schema.
